description: Defines the PerformanceTrackerLog entity class for ORM, including properties, constants, and getter/setter methods related to performance tracking logs in an HRM system.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerLog
classes.description: Entity class representing logs for performance tracking, with properties for log details, status, achievement, timestamps, and relations to performance tracker, employee, and user.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the performance tracker log.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the performance tracker log.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns the comment associated with the log.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of the log.

methods.name: getAddedDate
methods.description: Returns the date the log was added.

methods.name: setAddedDate
methods.description: Sets the date the log was added.

methods.name: getModifiedDate
methods.description: Returns the date the log was last modified.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee entity related to the log.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the User entity related to the log.
